input.quote: Contractor shall bill Company as set forth in the relevant Statement of Work. Each invoice submitted by Contractor will provide supporting detail for the Services invoiced, including, to the extent applicable to a particular engagement, the dates of Services and hours worked at the applicable rate by Statement of Work.
input.rationale: The Agreement grants RadialSpark no audit, inspection, verification or records-examination right against Clear Capital anywhere. Searches for audit, inspect, examine, verify, records, usage/compliance review and premises/system access returned no Vendor audit right; the compensation terms in Section 3 run one way only (Contractor invoices with supporting detail, and Company pays), and Section 1(c) gives Contractor personnel access to Company systems solely subject to Company's own security policies, not for verification purposes. With no audit right binding us, there is no frequency, notice, cost-allocation or system-access exposure to constrain, so our position is better than the preferred checklist and no redline is warranted; we should not volunteer audit machinery. If RadialSpark later requests verification rights, we would cap them at the fallback (once per year, 15 days' notice, Vendor cost unless underpayment exceeds 10%).
